title: Jeep Wrangler JK (2-door)
subtitle: Jeep · 2007–2018
specs: 3.8 L EGH V6 / 3.6 L Pentastar V6
buy: 3.6 Pentastar V6 (285 hp, 260 lb-ft) and 5-speed W5A580 automatic replace the 3.8 and the 4-speed
avoid: JK launch (production from August 2006): 3.8 EGH V6 (202 hp) with a 6-speed manual or 4-speed 42RLE…
owner: The JK took the Wrangler from a summer toy to a computer-controlled, power-windowed mainstream hit, and the two-door is the version that kept the old-school wheelbase.
